create-online-store.introTitle: What is an online store, and why do you need one?
intro: An online store is a website that shows your products with their photos and prices, and takes orders from your customers at any time. A customer picks a product, adds it to the cart and pays on delivery or by card, and the order reaches you with the customer's details and address.

Many sellers in Egypt start on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. That's a good start, but orders can get lost in messages, you answer the same questions about price and size again and again, and it's hard to measure your ads. An online store gives you one link with your brand's name to put in every post and ad, a page for each product that can show up on Google, and a dashboard for your orders, shipping and payments.
You don't need a developer or a big budget to create one. On Tallaby, you type your store's name and pick a ready-made template, then add your products and publish.

create-online-store.faqTitle: Questions about creating an online store

faq.q: How long does it take to create an online store on Tallaby?
faq.a: You can sign up, pick a template and add your products in a day, then publish when you're ready.

Creating a store is free. The Free plan has no monthly subscription, you don't need a credit card to sign up, and you pay $0.03 per order. To see orders and send campaigns, you need a first wallet top-up of $5. Order emails to your customers need the Order Notifications app, whose cost you see in your dashboard before you turn it on.

faq.q: Do I need a developer or technical experience?
faq.a: No. Every step happens visually in your dashboard, from picking a template to connecting payment and shipping.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Your store starts on a free link like yourbrand.tallaby.com, and you can connect a domain you own to your main store by adding its DNS records.
Cash on delivery is on from the start. You can connect Paymob or Kashier for cards and wallets, and take InstaPay and wallet transfers straight to your account.
Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself. Connect your Bosta account and issue waybills from your dashboard, download the Wassalha sheet or use your own riders, and set shipping rates by area.

faq.q: Can I bring products over from another store or page?
faq.a: Yes. Import your products from an Excel file, a product link or Shopify.
